greeting_message: Thank you for calling Acme Cloud Services. Please listen carefully to the following options: Press 1 for Sales. Press 2 for Technical Support. Press 3 for Office Hours and Location. Press 4 to leave a Voicemail. Press 0 to speak with an Operator.
business_hours: Our office is located at 100 Main Street, Suite 400. We are open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time. You can also visit us online at www.example.com.
sales_message: Connecting you to our Sales department. Please hold while we transfer your call.
support_message: You have reached Technical Support. All representatives are currently assisting other callers. Please hold, or press 4 from the main menu to leave a message.
operator_message: Transferring you to the front desk operator. One moment please.
voicemail_prompt: Please leave your name, phone number, and a brief message after the beep. Press pound when you are finished.
invalid_choice_message: Sorry, that is not a valid option. Please try again.
